basis: Manually inspected complete original Poppler page and288dpi ingredient detail; source OCR text supplied by web is not ground truth and misreads one-eighth as one-quarter.
registration_status: Unregistered source candidate; do not register as passing coverage before measuring all declared cases.
correlated_source_family: Both originals have exactly the same visible page; two PDF containers are not two independent semantic contents.
normalization: Headings: NFC and whitespace removal. Quantities: exact rational value, permitting Unicode vulgar fractions or equivalent ASCII/fraction-slash numeric spelling. No correction of wrong values.

reading_order.scope: Only the three visible headings in page order; not the hand silhouette, body prose or complete page reading order.

quantity_contexts.scope: Only the exact numeric quantity immediately before this ingredient context. Accept mathematically equivalent numeric fraction notation, not other ingredients or whole text fidelity.
